The public chooser presents five examples. Both discovery views show the amber
DEFER notice and no action recommendation before posterior diagnostics. The
narrow-screen layout remains readable and has no horizontal overflow. The
receipt view visibly refuses the duplicate upload, with neutral NOT_CHECKED
integrity / NOT_RUN replay and the trusted-anchor mismatch explained.

The seven automated UI cases passed. All five examples ran through the UI; a
downloaded receipt uploaded unchanged and verified against its retained digest;
a duplicate-key upload remained unchanged in transit and refused before hashing.
There were no page errors, console errors or requests outside the loopback
server. The isolated runtime directory contained only cosmic-commons.mjs both
before and after the run. The server and temporary directory were cleaned up.
